observations: Flat density, no detours: 35 main-road boxes in groups of 1-6; all-box differs from clear only by the bonus (17%) and three slot crates.
Each idea appears once alone before it is combined: single, edge pair, sandwich, striped single, enemy, pond, mask, 2x2 block, checkpoint, timed crate.
Slot crates sit right after C1 and right before the goal - the two places players pause.
Both masks precede the next enemy cluster; pits are fatal regardless (F3 intro).
Every frog pond holds or borders a crate group: slowing water, enemy and reward share one spot.
Four separate striped-crate payout warnings in one stage: the series teaches that how you break a crate matters.
Main-road crates per section 12/13/10; the bonus inflates C2 to 32.
Time crates (10 s) sit on block tops, stack tops, inside the 6-block and in the row: the trial tests vertical precision; walls give the fast line.
